verdicts.reason: Both lose the hands photo, the key image, and are broken. A: text is readable and well grouped, and the lower black strip with white crosses at least keeps the brand motif. But the image is cut into two meaningless black bands, the cloud shape is a ghost on the left, and the layout is off-balance with dead white space. B: only a black strip at the top is left, with no recognisable image at all. The crosses are faint, white-on-white and fragmented. The CTA/author gap is loose, and the bottom third is empty, so it is a bare text slide that has lost the original design.
